qr.title: QR login with the ThinQ app
qr.description:
Scan the QR code below with the **LG ThinQ app** on your phone, approve the login, then press **Submit**.

![QR code]({qr})

One-time number: **{pin}**

The QR code is valid for about 60 seconds. If it expires, press Submit to get a new one.
